caption: A photorealistic film still from a contemporary Chinese university romance short drama, cinematic live-action realism, square 1:1 image with 1024x1024 framing. Rich but natural skin texture, believable hands, fabrics and practical light, emotionally restrained acting, carefully staged subjects, no text, subtitles, logos or watermarks. Gu Xi is a 20-year-old Chinese female art student with long straight black hair, naturally expressive eyes, cream cardigan over white shirt and light blue jeans. Jiang Jin is a 22-year-old Chinese male computer science student with short neat black hair, charcoal jacket over white T-shirt, reserved face and a subtle old scar near his left wrist. Zhou Qian is a Chinese female student aged 21 with long wavy dark hair and powder blue outfit. H University digital art festival takes place in a real modern campus exhibition laboratory with a giant blue-violet LED display and realistic equipment. Focused close portrait of Gu Xi holding the chestnut bag at her waist, turning toward Jiang Jin in sudden suspicion after he mentions an intimate detail about her file naming routine. Her gaze is sharp and questioning. Jiang Jin is visible only as a softly out-of-focus shoulder and side profile on the right edge, pale blue digital exhibit lighting behind them. Realistic Chinese drama acting, eyes in crisp focus, quiet psychological tension.
